tax.text: His campaign says cutting taxes for working families is his top priority.
tax.quote: His top priority is cutting taxes and lowering costs for working families across the Commonwealth and the country.

wages.text: He says he strongly supports workers' rights to organize and collectively bargain for fair wages.
wages.quote: That’s why he strongly supports workers’ right to organize, collectively bargain, and earn fair wages for their work.

trade.text: He warned that tariffs can raise costs for families and small businesses.
trade.quote: He has also warned that reckless tariffs can drive up costs on everyday goods, disrupt supply chains, and make it harder for working families and small businesses to get ahead.

debt.text: He said he would oppose cuts to Social Security, Medicare, or Medicaid.
debt.quote: In Congress, Eugene will stand firmly against any attempt to cut Social Security, Medicare, or Medicaid.

housing.text: He led a bill to cut red tape, lower housing costs, and increase the supply of homes.
housing.quote: The U.S. House of Representatives yesterday passed bipartisan legislation led by Congressman Eugene Vindman (D-Va.-07) to cut red tape, lower housing costs, and increase the supply of homes in rural communities across the country.

schools.text: He supports federal funding and resources for public schools.
schools.quote: That’s why he’s fighting to ensure Congress provides the funding, resources, and support our schools need so that every student has a fair shot at success.

safety.text: He supports fully funding police while also saying public safety requires addressing poverty, addiction, and lack of opportunity.
safety.quote: He also understands that lasting public safety also requires addressing the root causes of crime, like poverty, addiction, and lack of opportunity.

immigration.text: He supports enforcement against transnational crime and violent criminals alongside simpler legal pathways.
immigration.quote: Eugene supports cracking down on transnational crime and violent criminals, alongside simpler, legal pathways for people who pay their taxes and are trying to do things the right way.

guns.text: He cosponsored a bill requiring background checks for every firearm sale.
guns.quote: To require a background check for every firearm sale.

abortion.text: He supports restoring abortion access nationwide and opposes bans on reproductive health care.
abortion.quote: Eugene will vote against any attempt to ban reproductive healthcare including abortion, IVF, or contraceptives.

gender.text: He voted against the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, which would set sports rules based on sex at birth.
gender.quote:
Vote Question: On Passage

Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act

cannabis.text: A voter guide records that he expressed support for federal cannabis legalization during a 2024 primary debate.
cannabis.quote: During a 2024 primary debate, Vindman expressed his support for federal legalization.

health.text: He supports strengthening the Affordable Care Act and protecting Medicare and Medicaid.
health.quote: In Congress, he’s working to lower the cost of prescription drugs, strengthen the Affordable Care Act, protect Medicare and Medicaid, and close the gaps in access that leave too many communities behind.

energy.text: He supports clean energy investment, reducing carbon emissions, and transitioning away from fossil fuels.
energy.quote: He supports bold investments in clean energy, efforts to reduce carbon emissions, transitioning away from fossil fuels, lowering energy bills for Virginians and policies that position Virginia as a leader in the green economy.

tax.text: He says he would ease the tax burden while maintaining essential services and reducing unnecessary spending.
tax.quote: I’m committed to easing the tax burden on families and businesses by promoting fiscal responsibility and reducing unnecessary spending.

debt.text: He said Social Security benefits should remain at their current level for older Americans.
debt.quote: absolutely need to maintain the status quo of Social Security

housing.text: He supports increasing housing supply by reducing development regulations and creating more units.
housing.quote: all levels of government should be promoting policies to increase housing supply.

schools.text: At a candidate forum, he advocated school choice options.
schools.quote: On parental rights, all emphasized parents’ primary role. Smithers shared personal sacrifices for Christian schooling. Harding linked strong families to solving societal issues. Ollivant advocated school choice options.

safety.text: He supports resourcing law enforcement, investing in policing, and holding criminals accountable.
safety.quote: I stand with law enforcement and believe they deserve the resources, training, and respect they need to do their jobs effectively.

immigration.text: He supports strong enforcement of immigration laws to deter unlawful entry.
immigration.quote: I support strong enforcement of our immigration laws to stop unlawful entry and deter those who exploit our system.

guns.text: He supports concealed-carry reciprocity and opposes requiring a government permit to purchase a firearm.
guns.quote: I support national concealed carry reciprocity so that law-abiding gun owners are not treated as criminals when they cross a state line.

energy.text: He prioritizes affordable, reliable power and supports natural gas and nuclear energy as central parts of an all-of-the-above approach.
energy.quote: Virginia’s families deserve affordable energy, and our communities need reliable power they can count on.

tax.text: He said he would reduce unnecessary federal spending and lower Americans’ tax burden.
tax.quote: My approach is straightforward: Spend less, tax less, avoid unnecessary foreign conflicts, and leave more money in the pockets of the American people.

debt.text: He supports significant spending cuts to reduce the national debt.
debt.quote: Government should remove itself from many areas it has no business being in and significantly cut spending in order to reduce the national debt.

housing.text: He supports reducing unnecessary regulations and permitting barriers to increase housing supply.
housing.quote: I would also encourage policies that allow states and local communities to reduce unnecessary permitting delays and barriers to increasing housing supply.

immigration.text: He proposes both restoring border control and a vetted legal-work process for undocumented immigrants already in the country.
immigration.quote: The American Controlled Immigration, Workforce and Security Act would restore control at the border while creating a lawful, vetted, accountable process for undocumented immigrants already here to come out of the shadows, work legally, pay taxes, and comply with our laws.

abortion.text: He describes abortion policy as primarily a state matter, supports access in serious medical circumstances and after rape, and favors protections for developing life later in pregnancy.
abortion.quote: I believe a woman should have access to abortion when a pregnancy presents a serious threat to her health or when the pregnancy resulted from rape or other forced circumstances.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He says biological males should not compete in women's sports because he considers it unfair to female athletes.
gender.quote: Biological males should not compete in women’s sports. They are physically stronger, and it is unfair to female athletes.

voting.text: In a candidate questionnaire, he strongly disagreed with allowing people to vote without photo identification.
voting.quote: People should be able to vote without photo identification.

tax.text: She supports asking people with greater means to contribute more to provide relief for working families.
tax.quote: Those with greater financial means can reasonably contribute more, while our policies should respect hard work and personal responsibility.

debt.text: She supported reducing government spending to reduce the national debt, while opposing across-the-board cuts.
debt.quote: I believe fiscal responsibility requires clear priorities, not across-the-board cuts.

schools.text: She strongly opposes eliminating the U.S. Department of Education and favors strengthening its role in equal access, civil rights, and quality education.
schools.quote: Rather than eliminating the U.S. Department of Education, we should strengthen its role in protecting equal access, civil rights, and quality education while working with states and local communities.

immigration.text: She supports timely, fair immigration processing, protecting refugees, and work authorization when authorized.
immigration.quote: Applicants who meet legal requirements and pose no criminal or national security threat should receive a timely and fair process.

guns.text: She supports comprehensive background checks, secure firearm storage, and measures to keep guns from people posing serious dangers.
guns.quote: I support comprehensive background checks, enforcement of existing gun laws, secure firearm storage, and reasonable measures

abortion.text: She says abortion should be limited to specified exceptional circumstances, including serious health risks, rape, incest, or hardship.
abortion.quote: I believe abortion should be limited to exceptional circumstances, including serious risks to the pregnant woman’s life or health, rape or incest

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: She agreed that biological males should not participate in women’s sports or occupy women’s intimate and vulnerable spaces.
gender.quote: I believe women and girls deserve fairness, safety, dignity, and privacy, particularly in competitive sports and intimate or vulnerable settings.

health.text: She supports a government-funded health coverage option for everyone while preserving the option of private insurance.
health.quote: I support a strong government-funded healthcare option available to all, while preserving the freedom of individuals and families to choose private insurance if they prefer.

energy.text: She proposes a diversified mix of nuclear and renewable sources with storage and a stronger grid while seeking reliable, affordable, clean energy.
energy.quote: I believe America needs a diverse energy strategy combining nuclear power, solar, wind and hydropower, supported by energy storage & a stronger grid.

voting.text: She supports access for eligible voters and secure alternatives so voters are not turned away for lacking a specific photo ID.
voting.quote: Voters should not be unnecessarily denied the right to vote because they lack a specific form of photo identification.

immigration.text: In a candidate questionnaire, he agreed that government should enforce border laws and prevent illegal entry.
immigration.quote: Government should enforce laws designed to protect the border and to prevent illegal entry of persons into the country. Agree

abortion.text: In a candidate questionnaire, Terry said abortion should be allowed only when the mother's physical life is in jeopardy.
abortion.quote: Should abortion be allowed under extenuating circumstances? If so, what circumstances? When mother's physical life in jeopardy
